item.title: Bajo una fuerte abstención, un partido cercano al rey gana las elecciones parlamentarias en Marruecos
item.description: El Partido Autenticidad y Modernidad (PAM), fundado en 2008 por uno de los consejeros del rey Mohamed VI, se impuso en unos comicios legislativos marcados por la abstención más alta en 20 años. Esa formación será la encargada de formar gobierno con sus actuales socios, el RNI –que había liderado el Ejecutivo actual– e Istiqlal. Deberán gestionar el descontento social por la falta de empleo y el alto costo de vida, mientras administran inversiones millonarias de cara al Mundial de fútbol en 2030. But Léger is less interested in reconstructing Gaetjens’s biography than in using the football star's journey as a " jumping point" to examining diaspora, fame, mortality and moral responsibility. item.title: FA charges Cardiff's Bielik as police end inquiry
item.description: The Football Association charges Cardiff City defender Krystian Bielik over an altercation involving Portsmouth fans, but a police investigation has been concluded. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Spotlight on new coaches as road to Afcon 2027 begins
item.description: Patrick Vieira and Herve Renard are among the high-profile managerial arrivals as the qualification campaign for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations gets under way. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Wales suffer scrum-half Lockwood blow for USA Test
item.description: Scrum-half Seren Lockwood is out of Wales' second WXV Test, against USA, after failing a head injury assessment. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Antonelli on 'stepping up' after 2024 crash 'stayed in my head for a very long time'
item.description: Championship leader Kimi Antonelli tells BBC Sport how he is "still finding my way" in F1 after a 2024 crash "stayed in my head for a very long time". Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Man Utd still £1bn in debt with £63.5m spent on new stadium
item.description: Manchester United's overall debt remains over £1bn despite Sir Jim Ratcliffe's extensive cost-cutting measures, with the club also confirming it has spent £63.5m buying land for their new stadium. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: England players carrying World Cup scar - Saka
item.description: England winger Bukayo Saka says the team are still carrying the "scar" of their heartbreaking World Cup semi-final exit to Argentina. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Pakistan must ‘catch up’ with India in T20 cricket, says coach Hesson
item.description: Pakistan could face India in the knockouts of the Asian Games, where the world champions won gold in 2023. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Ad break in Women's Champions League was unscheduled
item.description: Coverage of Arsenal's Women's Champions League opener also featured a dog on set, a vegetable platter and a rotating floor. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.description: Pick you best XI from the 2026 County Championship season. Who makes the cut? Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Pocognoli has 'positive nervousness' for Scotland debut
item.description: Scotland head coach Sebastien Pocognoli admits to feeling a "positive nervousness" before his first game in charge of the country, a Nations League tie against Slovenia in Ljubljana on Saturday. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Man City fight back to snatch 'precious draw' at Bayern Munich
item.description: Manchester City produced a superb fight back to recover from 2-0 down to draw 2-2 with German champions Bayern Munich in their opening match of this season's Women's Champios League. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: 'It can't be brushed over' - Republic of Ireland squad to discuss Israel games
item.description: Dara O'Shea says the Republic of Ireland squad will wait until after Thursday's Kosovo game before discussing how they approach Sunday's contentious fixture against Israel. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: 'It was scary' – Jacks goes from hospital bed to England match-winner
item.description: Will Jacks' career-best 50-over figures on Tuesday came shortly after the England all-rounder was rushed into hospital for emergency surgery while on a weekend away. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Yu, 13, completes hat-trick of golds at Asian Games
item.description: Thirteen-year-old swimming star Yu Zidi claims a dominant victory in the 400m individual medley to complete a hat-trick of gold medals at the Asian Games. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Scots recall Kerr & Thomas for World Cup play-offs
item.description: Sam Kerr and Martha Thomas are named in their first Scotland squad in almost a year for next month's World Cup round one play-offs against the Czech Republic. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Spain to face England on Saturday, after World Cup win
item.description: Spain’s World Cup-winning national team will return to action this weekend for its first match since lifting the trophy. The reigning champions will face England in their opening Nations League match, with the squad holding an open training session attended by large numbers of fans ahead of the game. Fuente: France 24 - English.
